whoosh.name: Air Whoosh
whoosh.desc: Clean directional air sweep that swells across the stereo field and dissipates softly.
whoosh.mix_hint: Align peak_offset_ms with fastest visual velocity; lower tone over sibilant narration.

pitch.description: Center resonance of body airflow and subtle tonal glide.

tone.description: High-frequency air sheen; lower to sit cleanly under speech.

punch.description: Tightness of the central swell crest.

space.description: Stereo travel width and subtle spatial spread.

impact.name: Soft Impact
impact.desc: Restrained tactile settle with warm low-end body and clean studio reflections.
impact.mix_hint: Align clip start (onset) with visual settle frame; lower pitch for deeper weight.

pitch.description: Fundamental body resonance; lower values sound deeper and heavier.

punch.description: Initial transient attack sharpness and upper harmonic click.

tone.description: Brightness of the overtone and filtered thump.

click.name: Tactile Click
click.desc: Crisp micro interface tap with subtle cavity resonance and zero harshness.
click.mix_hint: Keep gain restrained (-12 to -8 dB) so rapid interactions never distract from speech.

punch.description: Attack crispness and short harmonic snap.

riser.name: Tension Riser
riser.desc: Smooth upward shimmer and harmonic swell building cleanly into a reveal cut.
riser.mix_hint: End clip right at the reveal frame so peak_offset_ms hands off into the impact or cut.

length.description: Build duration leading into the reveal.

pitch.description: Starting harmonic center of the upward sweep.

tone.description: Upper shimmer brightness at the climax.

stinger.name: Brand Stinger
stinger.desc: Restrained institutional harmonic chime with crystalline overtones for logo or title lockups.
stinger.mix_hint: Place on open beat or title lockup; keep gain modest if BGM already has strong harmony.

pitch.description: Root note frequency (330 Hz ≈ E4, 262 Hz ≈ C4).

tone.description: Upper harmonic sheen and bell shimmer.

punch.description: Attack clarity on the initial chime.

swoosh_cut.name: Swoosh Cut

swoosh_cut.mix_hint: Center peak_offset_ms right on the crossfade cut frame; keep gain -14 to -11 dB under narration.

pitch.description: Center filter resonance of the cut body.

tone.description: Upper air sheen; reduce under sibilant speech.

punch.description: Tightness of the center crossing crest.

space.description: Stereo cross-panning width and subtle room tail.
